name: Muse Desktop
description: Unofficial learning adaptation of Muse Desktop for PI-Desktop, using host-configured models and replacement unicorn artwork.

en.name: Muse Desktop
en.description: Unofficial learning adaptation of Muse Desktop for PI-Desktop, using host-configured models and replacement unicorn artwork.
en.safetyNotes: Conversation text and the project folder path are sent to the model provider configured in PI-Desktop whenever you send a message (agent.complete). The plugin keeps its conversations and preferences in its own data directory. It can list a project folder, read files inside it for the preview pane, run read-only git status/diff, reveal a folder and open a terminal there, and open http(s) links in your browser. It cannot write files, run tools, or read credentials. Attachments and microphone input are unavailable and say so.

zh-CN.name: Muse Desktop
zh-CN.description: 基于 Muse Desktop 的非官方学习迁移版：适配 PI-Desktop 插件体系，使用宿主模型和替换后的独角兽素材。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 发送消息时，对话内容与项目文件夹路径会经 agent.complete 送到你在 PI-Desktop 中配置的模型服务商。插件把会话与偏好存在自己的数据目录。它可以列出项目文件夹、读取其中的文件用于预览、执行只读的 git status/diff、在资源管理器中定位文件夹、在项目里打开终端，以及用浏览器打开 http(s) 链接。它不写入文件、不运行工具、不读取凭据。附件与麦克风不可用，并会明确说明。
